text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's something that's been
bothering me for a while now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer...
You're so much more than I ever imagined—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: You've always, always... been so kind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...I know that everyone is kind. You too, Trainer. If I got hurt, I know you'd be sad."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Why... is everyone
so kind to me?

It's about that thing K.S.Miracle often brings up...
or rather, a habit in the way she thinks.
choice_data_list: (So I should take "kind" as a compliment, right…)
(When they say "kind," I'm supposed to take it as a compliment, right…)

text_block_list.text:
The first thing that caught my attention was probably when I first made and brought her a snack.
Back then, too, she called me "kind."

Back then, I felt a sense of discomfort but couldn't put it into words—
yet now, I think I've grasped its true nature a little.
choice_data_list: Hmm, something doesn't quite add up.
Hmm, something doesn't quite add up, huh?

text_block_list.text:
For instance, regarding the nutritional snacks,
the reason I prepared them is, quite simply,
"because it's K.S. Miracle."

Because I wanted to support her.
Because I wanted her to keep running healthily, with a strong body.
Because I wished for that more than anyone, I took action.

“Yet she simply chalks it up to
‘the Trainer being so kind.’
—Never once considering that the reason lies within herself.”
Is that deep-seated feeling of 'I have nothing, I possess nothing,' which took root in her childhood, coming into play here as well...?

Even within the gazes directed at her by others,
K.S.Miracle thoroughly excludes "herself."
choice_data_list: Everyone and I are looking at *you*, though...
Both I and everyone else are watching *you*, you know.

text_block_list.text:
Her way of looking at things like that
ultimately backed her into a tight corner.
Remembering what happened last year—
choice_data_list: (If only I could change things, even just a little at a time...)

text_block_list.text:
Take your time. As long as she learns
that there are feelings directed at her
precisely because she is who she is, and no one else.

...Thinking that far, an idea suddenly struck me. That's right,
it so happens the day for exchanging feelings is just around the corner.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... good morning, Trainer-san!
Let's have a great morning practice.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, before that... excuse me, just a moment. There's something I want to give you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um... Happy Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's really nothing special...
They're just white chocolate truffles, and super easy to make at that.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, while this is nowhere near enough
to truly express my daily gratitude...
Could you at least accept this?
choice_data_list: Of course! Thank you, I'm glad.

text_block_list.text:
First, while I gratefully accept this...
The truth is, the real deal for me begins now.
choice_data_list: Looks like Miracle's gonna get a lot today, huh?
Looks like Miracle's gonna get a lot today, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Oh, you mean the chocolate?
Well... maybe so...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm surprised every year.
Everyone is just so kind—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: Chocolate is supposed to be filled with feelings, you know.

text_block_list.text:
Yes, not just mere kindness,
not just simple "consideration."

"A 'feeling' directed toward someone,
carrying some form of purpose... to be handed over to them."

As K.S. Miracle remained bewildered,
I continued speaking. Slowly and carefully.
"If possible, about the chocolates you'll receive today—"
choice_data_list: Please try to understand the feelings behind it too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning, Miracle-chan!
Come, come, over this way~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We were just about to do a chocolate exchange!
Of course we've got some for you too, Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I really want you to look forward to it!
I mean, for Ryan-chan's this year, I took a leap
and went with cute little hearts—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Ines!?
It's fine, it's fine! Don't say it!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(A delicious tart from Ines, who's great at cooking.
And a cupcake topped with a cute, tiny heart from Ryan.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Both of them are truly wonderful Valentine's gifts, so...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you.
Giving some to me too, how swee—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Not... kind, then...?)
"Not that, but—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Not... like that... ?)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Wind God, Thunder God~!!
No sneaky runaway sprints allowed, ya hear?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trade with us too, Miracle☆
Taste the Demon Deco Impact~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally! It actually cost way more than what's inside!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you. Sorry, though...
My wrapping is kind of plain...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Just as she said, the wrapping is incredible.
An eye-popping sky-blue paper, tied with a yellow ribbon.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Written with about four different colored pens,
the words "To Miracle.")

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...For me? ...Are you giving this to me?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm? Miracle, what's up??

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, no...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Helios. When we were prepping, didn't you mention
there was something you wanted to say when you hand it over?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right!?
Palmer-chin, your assists are seriously god-tier~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle, Miracle! Listen!! I said it during the Mile CS too, but!! I'm—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Running with Miracle! Running with her forever! It's sooooo much fun, for realz☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's like, feel the chocolate f-e-e-l-i-n-g-s♡

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...'Feelings.' ...'Emotions.')

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (My 'feelings'......)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, Miracle!!
Take this friendship chocolate as a token of our fiery bond!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
They say sweets give you energy, after all!
Full of vigor, health comes first!!
So go ahead and eat up!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "It has mint in it." I wanted you to fully experience the refreshing breeze of the leaves.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And so, let us talk.
About the wind, in your own words, please.
...I will be looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: This is a new creation from a chocolatier I have been patronizing for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Back when I was still at home,
I, too, often enjoyed this person's sweets
as an accompaniment to tea."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I wholeheartedly guarantee its taste.
...If you would care to try.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Uh, well...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
I don't think... I really understood properly."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I should think about it more.
...I'll think on it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "While truly savoring everything everyone has given me... I want more."

It seemed she couldn't reach a conclusion.
However, K.S. Miracle showed
a definite change in how she faced things...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, well... I wonder.
I wonder how it is... I—
choice_data_list: ...Actually, I wanted to give something to you, too.
...Actually, I wanted to give something to you, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: !! Uh, ah, um—
choice_data_list: Thanks for always working so hard, Miracle.

text_block_list.text:
As I spoke, I firmly pressed the package into her frozen hands.
It was just ordinary chocolate,
but made with all my heart.
Then, K.S.Miracle—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
N-No... This is bad.
I can't take this, I'm... gonna lose it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer, because you told me to... I thought I had to think, I really wanted to think about it. But—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still... ngh, this isn't right.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Because Ines, Ryan, Palmer, Helios, Bamboo, Zephyr, Ruby—all of them—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, too.
Everyone... everyone is...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: To do all that... for someone like me...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, ...absolutely not!!
I don't think you should, um, probably."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: My chest is... way too, warm.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go crazy, man...
